item.description: Here's your Woodchuck Weather. Tonight, expect lows from the lower thirties to the upper thirties with cloudy skies and widespread rain likely across the region. Tomorrow, highs will range from the lower fifties to the mid-fifties under mostly cloudy skies, with a chance of light rain early in the morning and lingering showers possible late at night. Rainfall amounts tonight could reach up to half an inch in some areas, while additional showers tomorrow and tomorrow night will bring only light accumulations.
